title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt – Schusswaffe, Geld und Drogen beschlagnahmt

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors searched ten properties across several Berlin districts in a cocaine trafficking investigation against five suspects. A pistol, ammunition, about 50 kg of cannabis, 500 g of cocaine and around 100,000 euros in cash were seized, and one suspect was remanded in custody.
